suggested_lane.label: Grenell-Habba Congo transfer probe
suggested_lane.description: A New York Times scoop says the White House is investigating a $17.6M transfer from a Congolese government-linked account to Texas defense firm TX-AT, which has set Trump allies Richard Grenell and Alina Habba Mildon against each other.
